q1_issues.issue: In "Marra Tallowhand saw the wraith first" the adverb "first" is dropped with no atom at all, although the Ordinal rule covers the "first to V" rank reading.

"The Stilllight Lantern was warded" mints a second warding event sk_ward_2 instead of reusing sk_ward_1 from the immediately preceding sentence, so the KB records two distinct wardings where the text states one.
The aspectual tag is defined as (Already <event>) but is applied here to a LocatedIn atom, since a bare position clause mints no eventuality to anchor it.

The Result link for "burned dim" asserts a caused result where resultative vs depictive is genuinely unclear, and the instruction set says to omit Result and keep the plain state in exactly that case.
"turned away" is rendered as the bare head turn with the particle "away" unrepresented, which the phrasal-verb rule bars unless "away from" is read as a complex directional PP.

q2_gaps: aspectual "already" over a bare copular / locative position clause ("was already at the Lantern") — the particle needs an eventuality to tag and such a clause mints no event; the parallel "remained / stayed + locative PP" continuation is explicitly recorded as having no carrier
notes: Sentence 1's past-perfect anteriority is carried only by sentence 2's (BeforeBy sk_burn_1 sk_emerge_1 9 day), from which seeded rules derive the plain Before, so I read the absent Before atom as licensed rather than as a missing ordering. The rest follows the instruction set closely: multi-word Name plus separate kind atoms, event coreference for the restated burning, the group witness for bare-plural "feathers", the Near / Around / Against surface-preposition obliques, and the strength-0 conjunction for the final denial with definite typing projected.
